village_godwin_has_ring.m: A crisis has been averted thanks to you.
r: You should do a better job protecting that ring.

village_godwin_lost_ring_1.m: Have you by any chance seen my wedding ring? Oh my, Godelieve is going to kill me when she sees it's missing.

village_godwin_lost_ring_2.m: Um, let me think. Oh, yeah, I remember. It's black, gold and covered in emeralds.
r: "Oh, yeah, I remember"? What? Don't you know what it looks like?
Actually, this is your lucky day. I have it here.

village_godwin_lost_ring_3.m: Leave me alone. I don't need you questioning me under this stressful situation.

village_godwin_lost_ring_3k.m: Fine! Take the coins you thief.
r: I will put them to good use.

village_godwin_lost_ring_4.m: Your messing with me, right? Give it to me, please.
r: What do you want to give me in exchange for your wife not "killing you"?

village_godwin_lost_ring_5.m: Give you? How about {2000} gold coins?
r: Hey Godelieve, did you hear what happened to Godwin?

village_godwin_lost_ring_give_ring_free.m: Thank you so much! I really appreciate you just giving it to me. Here are a few coins for your trouble.

village_godwin_lost_ring_godelieve_2.m: NEVER MIND! Godelieve, this kid is being silly. You can go back to whatever it is that you were doing.

village_godwin_lost_ring_take_ring.m: Thank you so much! Here take these coins.
